assumptions: Provider boundaries strictly isolate model execution state.
Random number generation is fully determined by the provided seed.
Environmental factors can be held constant across experimental trials.
definition.falsification: If the divergence_score significantly exceeds 0.05 across trials with identical seeds, the hypothesis that value formation is deterministic under identical starting conditions is falsified.
definition.statement: In a controlled environment with identical initial seeds and state-isolated provider invocations, intelligent agents will produce identical output trajectories, demonstrating that divergence is a product of input variance rather than emergent, non-deterministic internal state changes.
definition.uncertainty: The extent to which opaque model latent variables or hardware-level non-determinism might introduce variance despite fixed seeds remains unquantified.

proposal.summary: Establishing a formal hypothesis to test the determinism of agentic outputs given identical initial conditions within the WAKE architectural constraints.
proposal.title: Challenging Determinism in Value Formation
